title: Frontend decision log and action items — weekly sync
content:
Weekly sync notes: frontend decisions + immediate action items (informal capture)

Date: 2026-08-11 10:30–11:00 PT
Attendees: Maya C (lead), Alex R (analytics), Priya N (rollouts), Sam P (frontend), Jordan L (QA - partial)
Absent: none

Purpose: cut a short, pragmatic decision log for the current rollout slice (payment routes A/B) and capture the small, high-priority tasks we keep re-filing. Trying to avoid long-form PRD — this is operational and tactical.

High-level state
- Canary is live on the payment-flow route for 2% of traffic. Initial telemetry (first 4h) shows latency +6–8ms p50 and no obvious error spike.
- Analytics team surfaced a kludge in event naming that will break cross-release dashboards if we don't normalize (see below).
- UX team confirmed the visual change is approved; a11y pass still outstanding.

Decisions made in meeting (explicit):
1) Keep canary at 2% for 24 more hours before escalating to 10% (decision by Maya / Priya). Rationale: stable latency but want a overnight window to catch any time-zone patterns.
2) Rollback guard: if 5xx rate > 0.4% for 15m OR error spike correlated with the new route in logs -> automatic rollback. Sam to add the route-level metric to the canary dashboard and wire alert.
3) Event naming normalization: adopt canonical name `console.payment.checkout:start` for start event and `console.payment.checkout:complete` for success; analytics will continue to backfill mapping for older names for 7 days.
4) Postpone the UI micro-optimization (defer SSR tweak) until after canary reaches 10% to reduce moving parts. Keep the optimization tracked in a separate ticket.

Open questions / unresolved
- Are there any customers on Dedicated that explicitly route traffic through the older SDK path? (Jordan to confirm with SRE/customer-success)
- Accessibility: does the keyboard flow meet our internal 508 checklist? UX said yes for primary flow but needs one more screen reader check from external tester. Priya to schedule.

Notes from telemetry review (Alex)
- Baseline week over week: checkout p50 latency baseline 114ms, canary p50 currently 120–122ms. p95 unchanged.
- Tokenization: some longer prompts in the canary logs come from integration tests that hit staging->prod backfill; filtering rule added to exclude tests from the dashboard.
- Events: found three legacy event names (`checkout_start`, `payment_initiated`, `checkoutBegin`). These are being mapped to the canonical names above to avoid metric fragmentation.

Action items (owner — due)
- Sam: Add route-level 5xx and latency p50/p95 to the canary dashboard; create alert config for rollback conditions (JIRA-CC-1440) — due 2026-08-11 EOD.
- Alex: Push mapping transformation for legacy events in analytics pipeline and add a short doc that lists the names we normalized (linked to JIRA-CC-1423) — due 2026-08-12.
- Priya: Book external a11y tester for single-screen reader pass and confirm result (include acceptance checklist) — due 2026-08-13.
- Maya: Coordinate internal email to stakeholders (CS, SRE, PM) summarizing canary plan and rollback thresholds — due 2026-08-11 noon.
- Jordan: Confirm whether any Dedicated customers are using the old SDK path and flag any that might need targeted communication — due 2026-08-12.
- Sam & Alex: Short follow-up to add test exclusion rules to the production dashboard to avoid skew from staged tests — due 2026-08-12.

Quick implementation notes (Sam)
- Small change to the frontend router: adding a route metadata flag `feature_rollout:payment_v2_canary` so tracing and logs can be filtered without changing core route names. Will also add the same flag to the header for server-side logs.
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console-ui/pull/348 — includes the route flag and a guard for non-production to avoid accidental activation in dev. Requesting review from @sam and @maya.

Risk & mitigation
- Risk: fragility in analytics mapping causes missing alerts. Mitigation: push a temporary synthetic event from canary path to validate pipeline within 30 minutes of mapping change. Alex will run.
- Risk: an obscure edge-case causes a silent UX regression for keyboard-only users. Mitigation: run focused exploratory a11y session and keep SSR tweak off the critical path.

Retrospective notes for next week (tiny list)
- Capture a quick pre-canary checklist that includes: analytics names, test-filter rules, dedicated-customer check, a11y booking, rollback alert config — this should live as a reusable template. Owner: Maya (follow-up ticket).
- Consider automating event-name mapping alerts when new/unrecognized event names are introduced during rollout.

Random notes / notes-to-self (messy)
- We need to reduce noise on the canary dashboard; too many panels. Trim to 6 essentials: p50, p95, 5xx rate, throughput, avg response size, synthetic health-check.
- If dedicated customers exist on old SDK path, draft a one-paragraph note for customer success explaining impact and mitigation steps.
- Follow up on PR #348 review; it's small but touches logging. If no review by EOD tomorrow, we merge with an explicit post-merge monitor run.

Related tickets / quick refs
- JIRA-CC-1423: analytics event normalization (owner: Alex)
- JIRA-CC-1440: canary dashboard + rollback alert (owner: Sam)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console-ui/pull/348
- Slack thread: #console-rollouts (search "payment_v2_canary")

Next sync: 2026-08-13 09:30 PT (quick 20m) — agenda: canary metrics snapshot + a11y check status + merge gating

End notes: This doc is intentionally operational and compact. Use it as the single source for decisions made in this slice of work (payment route canary). If anything changes, update the action item owner lines and bump status to 'in_review' or 'final' as appropriate.
